comment: Effects built from DSP that is resident on the instrument and unreachable from it.
Every UGen named here is registered by one of the 96 plugin .so that scsynth loads
at boot, and has NO class in las-fx/SCClassLibrary -- the library the instrument's
own sclang compiles against. So the instrument cannot write these into a SynthDef,
and never has. See docs/firmware/gap-sc-ugen-plugin-inventory.md section 5.2, which
names ReverbUGens.so specifically: FreeVerb, FreeVerb2 and GVerb are all resident
The graphs are compiled HERE, by a real sclang, and shipped as bytes. scsynth
resolves UGens by name string at /d_recv time, so a definition compiled elsewhere
works as long as the name matches -- which is the whole route this exploits.
Each effect sits at the TAIL of the root group, after everything Moog's rack does,
and ReplaceOut's the main pair. It never touches the five effect slots, and it never
frees a LADSPA node: /n_free on one of those terminates scsynth (see docs/DANGER.md).

effects.name: voxFreeVerb2
effects.title: FreeVerb2
effects.blurb: A stereo Schroeder reverb. Cheap, well behaved, and resident on your instrument since the day it shipped.
effects.graph: |left = 7, right = 0, mix = 0.25, room = 0.7, damp = 0.5, ceiling = 0.95| var l = In.ar(left, 1); var r = In.ar(right, 1); var w = FreeVerb2.ar(l, r, mix, room, damp); ReplaceOut.ar(left, Limiter.ar(w[0], ceiling, 0.005)); ReplaceOut.ar(right, Limiter.ar(w[1], ceiling, 0.005))

effects.name: voxGVerb
effects.title: GVerb
effects.blurb: A big physical-room reverb. Mono in, stereo out, so the two channels are summed before it and cross-faded back against the dry pair.
effects.graph: |left = 7, right = 0, mix = 0.2, roomsize = 40, revtime = 3, damping = 0.5, ceiling = 0.95| var l = In.ar(left, 1); var r = In.ar(right, 1); var w = GVerb.ar((l + r) * 0.5, roomsize, revtime, damping, 0.5, 15, 0, 0.7, 0.5, 300); var x = (mix * 2) - 1; ReplaceOut.ar(left, Limiter.ar(XFade2.ar(l, w[0], x), ceiling, 0.005)); ReplaceOut.ar(right, Limiter.ar(XFade2.ar(r, w[1], x), ceiling, 0.005))
